enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping through the night, light off, air conditioner on low
enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Keep eyes closed. Breathe regularly. Turn onto left side. Adjust pillow under head. Pull blanket to chest. Turn onto right side. Bend knees. Straighten legs. Turn onto back. Place arm over eyes. Remove arm. Turn onto left side. Pull blanket over shoulder. Remain still. Breathe. Sleep continues.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up slowly, washing face, brushing teeth, and taking morning medication for the managed chronic condition
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Take medication. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Making a quiet holiday breakfast with the kettle and toaster, sitting to eat and take the rest of the morning medication
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Fill kettle. Boil water. Place bread in toaster. Toast bread. Pour tea. Butter toast. Sit at table. Eat breakfast. Take medication.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking the dog along the local streets and park, keeping to familiar routes for a sense of safety
enriched_activities.desc: Leash dog. Open door. Walk out. Close door. Walk along street. Turn left. Walk through park. Turn right. Walk home. Open door.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing up breakfast dishes, loading the dishwasher, wiping counters, and putting away dry items
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up dishes. Scrape food into bin. Rinse dishes. Load dishwasher. Turn on dishwasher. Wipe counter. Put away dry cups. Put away dry plates.

enriched_activities.activity: Dressing, making the bed, and a short quiet prayer and reflection time at the desk
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out clothes. Change clothes. Make bed. Pull up sheets. Flatten pillows. Sit at desk. Open book. Read.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting with the phone sending one-on-one text check-ins to relatives and neighbors, reading every reply in detail
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Select contact. Type message. Send. Read reply. Select next contact. Type message. Send.

enriched_activities.activity: Sorting laundry, running the washing machine, and vacuuming the hallway and living areas
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to laundry. Open laundry basket. Sort clothes into piles. Pick up whites. Load washing machine. Add detergent. Close door. Press start. Pick up vacuum cleaner. Plug in. Turn on. Vacuum hallway. Vacuum living room. Turn off. Unplug.

enriched_activities.activity: Walking to the local shops to buy groceries with cash, sticking to a budget but picking up a couple of extra items
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up shopping bag. Walk out door. Walk to shops. Enter shop. Pick up basket. Pick up apples. Place in basket. Pick up milk. Place in basket. Pick up bread. Place in basket. Walk to checkout. Pay with cash. Receive change. Put items in bag. Walk home. Unlock door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking a simple lunch on the induction cooker and reheating items in the microwave
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open fridge. Take out items. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off. Plate food.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch alone at the table and resting quietly after the meal
enriched_activities.desc: Carry plate. Place on table. Sit. Eat. Drink. Finish. Clear plate. Sit back. Close eyes. Rest.

enriched_activities.activity: Catching up on remote paperwork and community outreach notes on the computer, since the clinic and school are closed for the public holiday
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to study. Turn on light. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Enter password. Open document. Type notes. Scroll. Save. Open email. Read messages. Reply. Close email. Open spreadsheet. Enter data. Save. Shut down.

enriched_activities.activity: Brief community visit to a neighbor to drop off supplies and check on their wellbeing, on foot
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up bag of supplies. Walk out door. Lock door. Walk to neighbor's house. Knock on door. Wait. Neighbor opens door. Say 'Hello, I brought supplies.' Hand over bag. Ask 'How are you doing?' Listen. Nod. Say 'Take care.' Walk back home. Unlock door. Enter.

enriched_activities.activity: Second dog walk around the block, taking a calm and familiar route
enriched_activities.desc: Leash dog. Open door. Walk out. Close door. Walk around block. Turn left. Walk past park. Turn right. Walk down street. Return home. Open door. Unleash dog.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering with the water heater and changing into comfortable evening clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on water heater. Remove clothes. Step into shower. Turn on water. Wet. Apply soap. Rinse. Turn off. Dry. Dress.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing dinner using the oven and induction cooker, organizing portions and cleaning as I go
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open fridge. Take out ingredients. Place on counter. Turn on oven. Preheat. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Place meat in oven. Set timer. Clean counter. Wash knife.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating dinner at the table, keeping the meal calm and unhurried
enriched_activities.desc: Carry plate. Place on table. Sit. Eat. Drink. Finish. Clear plate. Sit back. Rest.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching television with the air conditioner on, winding down from the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Select channel. Watch. Adjust volume. Watch. Change channel. Watch. Turn off TV. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Sitting with the computer to help with homework tasks and review the week's appointment and shift schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to study. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open homework file. Read. Type answers. Save. Close. Open calendar. Review appointments. Check shift schedule. Make notes. Close calendar. Shut down computer. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Text-only one-on-one check-ins with relatives and neighbors on the phone, asking after every detail
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up phone. Unlock. Open app. Select contact. Type message. Send. Read reply. Select next contact. Type message. Send.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash, taking nighttime medication, and setting out clothes for the next day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Brush teeth. Take medication. Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Set out clothes.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching a little television at low volume, then turning off the light and going to sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Lower volume. Watch. Turn off TV. Put down remote. Lie down. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep.
